title: Magnetic Seizure Therapy for Schizophrenia - Trial
official: Magnetic Seizure Therapy for Schizophrenia - Trial
summary: This trial aims to assess the clinical effects and tolerability of Magnetic Seizure Therapy (MST) as an alternative to electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) for Treatment Resistant Schizophrenia (RS).
